نتدلدل (form IIq)
# نَتَدَلْدَلُ (natadaldalu) /na.ta.dal.da.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَدَلْدَلَ (tadaldala)
# نَتَدَلْدَلَ (natadaldala) /na.ta.dal.da.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَدَلْدَلَ (tadaldala)
# نَتَدَلْدَلْ (natadaldal) /na.ta.dal.dal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَدَلْدَلَ (tadaldala)
